resources.string:
A transposed game is a PC game whose x86-64 code was translated once and for all to ARM64 by the static recompiler: it runs here without Wine or Box64.

On a PC, run scripts/transpose.ps1 on a Windows executable, then import the resulting .rcn.zip package here.

Research prototype: only console programs using a small part of the Windows API run for now.
The transposed game and its files are removed from this device.
